item.title: Is 99.9x% cache hit always better?
item.summary: Support a problem needs at least 10k tokens new information. If cache hit is 99% ... input 0 cache created 10k (prefect) cache read 1M! Extremely, if a clever agent get all 10k information, and give the answer directly, the cache hit is 0%! Cache hit rate should be healthy, but if it gets 99.9x%, I think it is that the information incr is too small per step!
